text: You learned the local greeting and everyone smiled. Welcome!
A friendly local showed you a shortcut through the old town.
You caught an earlier flight and landed with time to spare.
You helped a lost tourist find their way. They gave you a little souvenir!
Free upgrade to first class — a comfy seat and extra snacks!
You packed light and zoomed through the airport while everyone else queued.
Your travel insurance came in handy. Nothing can go wrong now!
You swapped postcards with a new friend from another country.
You tried a food you'd never heard of — and loved it!
The tour guide picked you to ring the bell at the top of the tower.
You said three words in the local language and a whole café cheered.
A rainbow appeared right over your hotel. What a view!
You found your lost phone in the seat pocket. Phew! Stamps for staying calm.
The train was late, but you stayed cheerful and made friends in the queue.
Your tour bus takes you straight to {landmark}!
A hot-air balloon ride gives you the best view of {landmark}. Up, up and away!
You took a night train and woke up far from where you started.
You learned to say thank you in five languages. Everyone is impressed.
You gave your seat to an older traveller and got a big smile.
You won a dance-off at the street festival!
You took a wrong turn and found the best bakery in town.
You shared your map with a family who were lost. Teamwork!
You picked up litter on the beach and the whole town thanked you.
Not a single suitcase went missing today. Everything arrived on time!
You took the scenic route and spotted a famous sight from the train window.
A friendly pilot invited you to peek into the cockpit.
You danced with a street musician and shared your snack with the crowd.
You carried a stranger's heavy suitcase up all the stairs. What a hero!
You missed your train by thirty seconds. Sit this one out.
You left your passport at the hotel! Hurry back.
Your luggage went to the wrong country. Hello, borrowed socks!
You got on the bus going the wrong way.
Your flight was delayed by a storm. Wait here.
You forgot to charge your phone, so no map! Back to {landmark}.
You tried to bargain in the wrong language and paid triple.
A seagull stole your sandwich right out of your hand!
You fell asleep on the train and missed your stop.
The hotel gave away your room. You spent the night in the lobby.
You wore flip-flops on a mountain hike. Blisters!
Lost in the old town — every street looks the same! Back to {landmark}.
Your suitcase was too heavy and you had to pay extra.
You forgot your sunscreen and now you look like a tomato.
Traffic jam! Everyone in the taxi is stuck.
You missed the last ferry and had to sleep on the pier.
You dropped your ice cream on the very first lick.
You trusted a map that was upside down. Back to {landmark}.
You pushed into the line at the museum and got sent to the back.
Rain, rain, rain! The whole day of sightseeing is cancelled.
You left the tour bus without telling the guide, and it left without you.
You pressed the wrong button and ordered twelve bowls of soup.
You forgot about the time zone and arrived a whole day late.
Your camera battery died right before the best photo of the trip.
You complained loudly about the queue instead of being patient.
You lost the group in a crowded market. Hurry back to {landmark}!
You ignored the 'wet floor' sign. Splash!
A strong headwind forces your plane to take a longer route.
